下列代码里 while 循环执行了几次？

nums = [6, 11, 78, 86, 99, 144, 156, 162, 273, 293, 454, 459, 495]
lo, hi = 0, len(nums) - 1
c = 0
while lo <= hi:
    c += 1
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if nums[mid] == 273:
        break
    elif nums[mid] < 273:
        lo = mid + 1
    else:
        hi = mid - 1
print(c)

questions.question:
下列代码里 while 循环执行了几次？

nums = [27, 60, 235, 259, 261, 267, 269, 333, 399, 405, 410, 431, 482, 486, 491]
lo, hi = 0, len(nums) - 1
c = 0
while lo <= hi:
    c += 1
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if nums[mid] == 482:
        break
    elif nums[mid] < 482:
        lo = mid + 1
    else:
        hi = mid - 1
print(c)
